motion.easePressUse: sub-200ms CSS/gesture transitions on things you can touch (press/hover feedback), not entrance motion

SPRING_UI.use: chrome that repositions: sidebar rail, panels

SPRING_MOMENTUM.use: only a release that carried velocity: a flick, a throw, a drag let go

tempo.rationale: single shared timing grid so sequenced animations land on the same underlying pulse instead of arbitrary per-component numbers; a quiet nod to the music-production identity, not a literal audio cue

gestureHelpers.project: project(velocity, decelerationRate = 0.998) — exponential-decay projected rest point of a flick, not v^2/2a; commit on projected rest + velocity sign, never raw distance dragged
gestureHelpers.rubberband: rubberband(overshoot, dimension, constant = 0.55) — progressive resistance applied only past a real boundary; applying from the first pixel makes the element lag the finger

motion.reducedMotion: drag gestures keep tracking (not vestibular motion); only the settle changes — spring swaps to { duration: 0 } and overshoot drops

breakpoints.lg: single cutoff switching Sidebar between vertical rail (desktop) and top bar (mobile)
breakpoints.sm/md: used within either nav mode to step content padding and grid columns, e.g. px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12

narrative.northStar: Instrument panel — a near-black, hairline-ruled engineering surface with one continuous ambient field behind it and a music-derived BPM-92 timing grid.
narrative.overview: A flat, orthogonal foreground of rules and text sits in front of the site's only volumetric layer, WaveField. Density is high but controlled by a four-role type scale and measure caps; colour is rationed to three greys and one blue, split by contrast role rather than taste. Every reveal times off a shared beat grid instead of a per-component guess, and entrances resolve out of defocus, echoing the ambient layer's own optical language.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and orthogonal in the foreground, volumetric in one background layer only
Hairlines, not cards — no elevation system, no radius above rounded-sm, no shadow-as-depth
Three greys, one blue, split by role (accent for shapes, accent-text for words)
One shared BPM-92 timing grid instead of per-component durations
Depth by defocus, never by drop shadow
rules: accent (#2563eb, 3.87:1) is for shapes only; accent-text (#4478ee, 4.93:1) is required for anything read as words
no corner radius above rounded-sm anywhere
only four legitimate shadow uses exist: Sidebar rail, ScrollProgressRail bloom, OrbitStage ring, SignalRule bloom — nothing else may add a shadow
every display tier is a clamp(); never add an sm:/lg: size step to a display element
Clash Display's axis tops at 700; font-bold is the ceiling, font-extrabold would be synthesized
small dim text (meta/micro, colored dim/dim2) takes +0.01em tracking (--track-text-sm); uppercase micro-labels keep their own +0.08em instead
WaveField is the site's only continuous ambient animation; a second animated background layer is banned
SK wordmark is the one documented exception to the type scale
dos: separate surfaces with a hairline (border or rule) or nothing
use accent for shapes, accent-text for words
source every type size from the four text roles and four display tiers
derive every animation duration from beats() / EASE_OUT / the named springs
donts: never dim text with an opacity modifier (text-fg/70 is a guess, not a measured colour)
never add a second ambient animated background layer
never use a shadow as card elevation
never let accent (#2563eb) carry a word
never introduce a fifth text size or a hand-picked literal size at a callsite
never reintroduce a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading
never reach for rounded-lg/rounded-xl or a gradient-pill tag
